description: Create a transaction proposal with raw EVM calls. Use for any on-chain action including contract interactions, approvals, and swaps.

account.description: The smart account address to create the proposal from (0x-prefixed, 40 hex chars)

calls.description: Array of raw EVM calls; on the CLI, pass one JSON array. Each call has 'to' (address), 'data' (hex calldata), and optional 'value' (wei as string)

value.description: Value in wei as a string (defaults to '0')

chainId.description: The chain ID where the smart account is deployed (e.g., 1 for Ethereum, 8453 for Base)

memo.description: Optional memo for the transaction (max 500 chars)

name.description: Optional name for the proposal. If omitted, auto-generated from call details

properties.description: Optional custom JSON metadata. Total minified ≤ 500 chars. Used as the base; any --property overlays are applied on top. To load from a file, use shell substitution: --properties "$(cat props.json)"

property.description: String key/value overlays for properties; repeatable. Splits on the first '='.

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: transactions_create_custom
